subject: [PATCH v4 05/13] mm/collapse: state what a collapse may do in the policy

2026-09-29.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new struct called collapse_policy to store the policy decisions made by the caller before asking for a collapse. The policy includes limits on missing, swapped-out or shared PTEs in a window, as well as other settings such as whether to look at used ranges and how to handle MADV_FREE'd pages. The patch replaces scattered tests throughout the collapse path with reads from the collapse_policy struct, simplifying the code and removing the need for khugepaged to look up who called it. The policy is filled once per scan pass by khugepaged and once per call by MADV_COLLAPSE.
